Reporter independently observed a dry-run boolean receipt without canonical settings on published 2026.9.30. Named governance preset normalization is correct, but the callback proposal differs from the effective persisted result. No settings/history preview writes were reported. Current-tree design and implementation are pending.

Requested contract: A copied extension can obtain the exact validated effective settings preview through the host capability without duplicate normalization or a local SDK runtime import.

Verification plan: reproduce the public report in a temporary project outside this checkout with both PM roots isolated, demonstrate a relevant regression, then validate the SDK boundary, thin transport where applicable, complete coverage and packed consumers. No implementation is included in PR #1353.
GH-1356: SDK: expose the canonical settings preview through host-bound audited mutation
Expose an opt-in canonical settings preview through the injected audited extension command SDK.

An opt-in host-bound preview matches actual canonical persistence for named and custom presets; Ordinary mutation receipts remain bounded and backwards compatible; Preview is read-only for settings and immutable history; Invalid settings, locks, concurrency and replay retain existing guarantees; A copied packed extension without a local SDK import demonstrates preview parity
